title: Section 187 BNSS — Procedure when investigation cannot be completed in twenty-four hours

content.heading: Procedure when investigation cannot be completed in twenty-four hours
content.text: Whenever any person is arrested and detained in custody and it appears that the investigation cannot be completed within twenty-four hours, the nearest Magistrate may authorise detention otherwise than in police custody, and police custody as enacted, subject to the outer limits. Default bail arises if the police report is not filed within the prescribed sixty or ninety days. Read the official clauses. This is the successor of CrPC 167.
